capabilities: Add books via a modal with title, author, genre, year, pages, status, rating, review, quotes, and themes
Filter books by reading status in a library sidebar
Auto-create theme notes and link books to them
Store all book data as frontmatter in plain markdown
extras: The listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README covers features, commands, and folder structure but has no usage examples or screenshots.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to catalog reading: book metadata, reading status, ratings, and reviews must be assembled by hand.
summary: Reading tracker that stores books with status, ratings, reviews, quotes, and theme links in frontmatter, with a filtered library sidebar.
